title: ProjectConfig
description: A knowledge base's committed `.semiont/config.yaml`: its name, whether its changes are staged in git, and its permanent identity. A deployment's documents never restate any of it.

name.description: The knowledge base's name, which decides where its state is kept.

version.description: A version the knowledge base's author gives it. Nothing changes it.

git.description: How the knowledge base's changes reach git.

sync.description: Whether changes to the working tree and the event log are staged in git as they are made.

domain.description: The knowledge base's permanent identity, in did:web's colon-path form (`owner.github.io:repo`): stamped into every event it records, so never a machine's address and never changed. With no white space in it, which no DID holds (UserId.json).

siteName.description: The name people see for the knowledge base.
